name: Crisp dawn
story: The coldest dawn of the spring, the grass grey with dew and the air utterly still; by mid-morning a perfect, cloudless sky and 100 km of visibility. At night the aurora, pale green over the northern hills in the long twilight.
forecast: Clear and cold, 3-4 C at dawn. Calm, northwest 4-5 kt in the afternoon. Visibility 100 km. Clear night: aurora likely.
